author: Adam Conover
description:
Our world revolves around communications. But while the telegram and telegraph are dead and gone, one communications technology from the old timey era is still in the thick of it: the telephone. As AI plutocrats attempt to reorder our world around a new technology, it seems like a good time to examine a technology that already did just that. How did the phone survive this long, and how did it evolve and change us along the way? Joining me today is James Gleick, one of the best science writers working today, to discuss his new book The Telephone: A New History.
